title: A person-confirmed note stays ahead of an unconfirmed restatement
what: A guard of the restated-note rule (A33). Alice records a fact and a person (an admin) confirms it. Later Alice writes a note that gives the same fact key another value, and nobody confirms that one. Even from the same writer, an unconfirmed note never moves a confirmed one back: the confirmed note stays first and nothing is labelled as restated.
